Name: Swimsuit Selections
Author: AirynS
Description:
Want to wear something more stylish than a bikini or speedo? Are you trans or nonbinary and wish you weren’t forced into wearing a typically gendered swimsuit? Wish you could cover up a little (or a lot!) more? This mod changes the farmer’s default swimsuit to one of a variety of swimsuit options in a multitude of colours for either body type!

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]TopOption[/b]: This changes what your farmer wears on the top half of their body. Options include a bikini top, a tankini, a short binder, a long binder, a rash vest, a t-shirt, or the default option for your body type (bikini top for AFAB farmers, shirtless for AMAB farmers). If a full-body option is chosen for [b]BottomOption[/b], this setting will do nothing.
[/list][list]
[*][b]BottomOption[/b]: This changes what your farmer wears on the bottom half of their body. Options include shorts, a wrap skirt, a swim skirt, a one-piece swimsuit, a swim dress, a short wetsuit, a full-length wetsuit, or the default option for your body type (bikini bottom for AFAB farmers, speedo for AMAB farmers).
[*][b]TopColour[/b]: This sets what colour the top part of your swimsuit (if not using a full-body option) will be.
[/list][list]
[*][b]BottomColour[/b]: This sets what colour the bottom part of your swimsuit or full-body swimsuit will be.
[/list]
All swimsuit options are available regardless of body type. Colours available are black, white, brown, red, orange, gold, light green, dark green, light blue, dark blue, light purple, dark purple, pale pink, and bright pink. If you would like an alternate colour added, feel free to send me the edited assets and I’ll add them in!

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod only requires Content Patcher and is compatible with Android. I have not tested it with JA clothing items, so please let me know if you encounter issues.[b]

Known minor issue:[/b] If you have pants equipped, your swimsuit may not match the colours in your config settings. Simply unequip them to fix (think of it as roleplaying! Immersion!)

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

The shorts, one-piece, short binder, and short wetsuit assets were created by Delta9T for their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/324]Delta’s Better Swimsuits[/url], which has open-use permissions.

Downloads.Description: The main download. To install, simply extract the [CP] Swimsuit Selection folder and drop it in your Mods folder.
